title: Plan: JustAPI deep audit and stabilization
description:
Master roadmap for auditing, remediating, validating, and documenting JustAPI before any Postman feature-gap work begins. The child tasks are ordered so evidence and the written remediation plan exist before production changes, high-risk correctness and security defects are handled before UX/refactoring work, and closure is based only on commands and smoke tests that were actually run.

Approved decisions:
- Migrate recognized Auth Builder credentials to VS Code SecretStorage.
- Remove tracked dependencies and use the lockfile as the reproducible source.
- Correct documentation for substantial unsupported capabilities instead of adding major features during stabilization.

Definition of done: every child task is completed or explicitly deferred with evidence and risk; all Blocker/Critical/High findings are resolved or externally blocked; the three audit artifacts are complete; runnable validation passes; packaging succeeds; no user data is silently lost; and the closure report states whether the repository is ready for the separate product-capability phase.

checklist.text: Establish the reproducible baseline and write the current-state architecture audit
Create the evidence-backed finding registry and remediation plan before production edits
Clean repository dependencies and restore reproducible delivery
Build the automated validation harness and continuous integration pipeline
Validate and correlate the webview message protocol
Introduce versioned atomic persistence, recovery, and migrations
Migrate authentication secrets and redact derivative artifacts
Make variable resolution deterministic, bounded, and consistent
Correct and harden the HTTP transport
Protect collection tree integrity and import/export round trips
Repair cURL parsing and unsupported-option reporting
Generate valid, normalized, secret-aware code snippets
Wire every contributed command and webview startup action
Stabilize webview state, history, search, response rendering, and accessibility
Decompose the provider into testable services without redesigning the product
Correct public documentation and record deferred capability gaps
Run final validation, execute smoke tests, and publish the closure report
